2026-10-22T10:00:00+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Quick round, I've got ten minutes. Paula, printing first.
2026-10-22T10:00:41+02:00 — Paula Dietrich: Demo programme goes to the printer on Friday if Nora's descriptions arrive by Thursday noon. If not, it goes with blank boxes and everyone gets to explain them.
2026-10-22T10:01:30+02:00 — Nils Braun: Course page: it's still on the old title. Jule asked me to hold every change until the new name is final.
2026-10-22T10:02:05+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Hold it, yes. Jule's last note to me was literally "If the board doesn't rename it, I'm out of ideas." She wants a better title, not a funeral. The board has decided now, so tell her she can stop fighting that headline.
2026-10-22T10:02:48+02:00 — Nils Braun: I'll tell her. She'll want the new name in writing before she touches the page again.
2026-10-22T10:03:20+02:00 — Sandra Kowalski: Fair. Last thing: whoever borrowed the projector adapter from room 2, bring it back. That's all.
